name: mvane yard
author: Alexandre Enkerli
tagline: a lead, bass and chord synth for any scale, always recording, expressive (MPE, wind controllers)
description: A lead, bass and chord synth for the M-VAVE FM-1. Chords from any scale on the white keys, their qualities latched (and combined) on the black keys as on Coral Flower, voiced smoothly over a separate bass, or single notes; a history that never stops, so a phrase becomes a take after the fact (eight slots, to a DAW as MIDI); expressive sounds: YARD, its own light synth, and Clipper's 337, by family and load, on both cores, with MPE in and out, per-voice MPE glide and wind controllers; your own sounds saved and moved as files; full-duplex USB audio and MIDI.
credits: Built on fm1-base (MPL-2.0) and felucca-bsp; the chord mode after Coral Flower's design (FicusFicusov); Clipper's synth vendored (GPL-3.0, by 3dSam and contributors, after SLOOP and Felucca by Leo Kuroshita).
